description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in Mallawapitiya, Kurunegala District. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
